announcements.html:
Hi everyone,

As required by 3600, all Biosafety Cabinets (BSCs) must be recertified annually. Our BSC recertifications are scheduled as follows:

  • Tuesday, September 15: Rooms 16-315 and 16-316
  • Wednesday, September 16: Room 16-317

Each BSC will need to be prepared before the TSS technician arrives. Prior to recertification, please remove all contents from the cabinet and decontaminate the work surface using an appropriate disinfectant. No cell culture work may be performed while the technician is servicing the cabinets. Please also review the attached information sheet in advance to help avoid any confusion and ensure that your cabinet is properly prepared.

Each certification will take approximately 30–45 minutes. The technician will begin at 9:00 AM and can service two cabinets at a time. Omar has arranged for the technician to start with our hoods first since we have a larger number of cabinets.

Please plan your work accordingly to minimize disruptions and make sure your BSC is ready before the technician arrives.

Thanks, and please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,

Max
